$description: TrustedRouter web brand system. Tokens follow the W3C Design Tokens format ($type/$value, {alias} references) and import into Style Dictionary or Tokens Studio. Values describe the trustedrouter.com homepage design; guide.homepage_exceptions lists the few places where the live homepage does not yet follow this kit.

meta.name: TrustedRouter web brand system
meta.source: Computed styles of the trustedrouter.com homepage at 1440, 800, 650 and 390px wide

dynamic_values.live_model_count: From the catalog source that renders /models

meta.scope: Every page on trustedrouter.com. The Token Exchange sites (nytokenexchange.com and the other city and region exchange domains) have their own design and are out of scope: do not restyle them to this kit, and do not use them as a reference for trustedrouter.com pages.

panel.$description: Cards, boxed modules, receipt, press card

panel-inset.$description: Fields and nested surfaces inside a panel, receipt nodes

hover.$description: Hover fill for secondary buttons, icon buttons and search results

overlay-button.$description: Secondary button fill, readable over the photo

secondary.$description: Body copy, ledes, nav links, code, quotes, FAQ answers

tertiary.$description: Meta, captions, mono labels, placeholders, table headers, IDs

on-photo.$description: Body text placed over the landscape photo

base.$description: Mint. Primary button, italic headline phrase, active filter underline, hero promises, checkmarks, open-accordion icon

ink.$description: Text on mint and on the tooltip

underline.$description: Resting underline under action links; switches to currentColor on hover

rule-soft.$description: Table lines, header bottom border, section-band bottom border

strong.$description: Secondary button border; hover border for controls

emphasis.$description: Highlighted node in a route diagram

connector.$description: Dashed connector in route diagrams (used at 70% opacity)

quote.$description: 2px rule beside a quote on the mint panel

focus.$description: Focus ring on dark surfaces. 3px solid, offset 4px

link.$description: Header nav links and status label

sans.$description: Self-hosted variable woff2, wght 100-900, font-display swap

mono.$description: System monospace, no webfont: SF Mono on Apple devices, Consolas on Windows. Use for model IDs, prices, labels and code

display.$description: Page H1, one per page. Max width 900px, text-wrap balance

h2-side.$description: Headline in a side column (FAQ), max width 320px

figure.$description: Lead number in a terms grid. Same size at every width

lede-hero.$description: Hero subhead, color text.on-photo, max width 530px

lede.$description: Section intro, color text.secondary, max width 38ch

lede-sm.$description: Intro inside a boxed module, max width 650px

body.$description: Default paragraph, color text.secondary, max width 66ch

body-sm.$description: Footnotes and table captions, color text.tertiary

quote.$description: Italic. A quote inside a quote is set upright

row-title.$description: Model or provider name in a table row (link)

eyebrow.$description: Uppercase kicker above a card or panel

label.$description: Uppercase table headers and field labels

data.$description: Prices, token counts, context length; tabular figures

id.$description: Model slugs, provider counts, color text.tertiary

code.$description: Code blocks. Same size at every width

legal.$description: Copyright and legal links, color text.tertiary

data-lg.$description: Cost in the route receipt; tabular figures

section.$description: Block padding of every content section

header-inline.$description: Header side padding: lines up with the 1280px container edge; 24px at <=880px, 20px at <=600px

panel.$description: Panels, cards, tags, chips, segmented tabs, receipt nodes

control.$description: Buttons, inputs, icon buttons, tooltips, search

round.$description: Status dot, back-to-top button (renders as a circle on square elements)

md.$description: Two-column modules (request, migration, FAQ) become one column; terms grid drops to 2 columns

nav.$description: Header collapses to a Menu drawer; footer drops to 3 columns

principles: Near-black green canvas, cream type, one mint accent. Colour carries meaning (privacy level, status, action), never decoration.
Proof over adjectives. Show the request, the price, the label, the commit. Diagrams are built from real UI (route receipt, catalog rows, code diff), never illustration.
The landscape photo appears only in a page's opening band and closing band, always under a scrim, never behind data, tables or body copy.
Flat surfaces. Separation comes from 1px rules and the two background steps; shadows are only for floating layers (tooltip, modal).
Archivo for what people read. The system monospace for what machines read: model IDs, prices, base URLs, labels, eyebrows, table headers.
Two corner radii: 2px for surfaces, 6px for anything you press or type into (12px for dialogs).
At most one italic mint phrase per headline, used for the payoff.

landscape_photo.subject: Aerial braided river valley between dark green-grey ridges at dusk. Low saturation, cool shadows.
landscape_photo.placement: Absolutely positioned, inset 0, z-index -2, object-fit cover, background {color.surface.photo-fallback}

inner_page_band.use: Optional opening band for Models, Compare and landing pages

rules: The hero scrim ends at #050706 so the next section starts seamlessly.
No other stock photography, people or 3D renders.

brand_mark.lockup: Mark + 'TrustedRouter' in Archivo 20px/600, letter-spacing -0.04em, gap 12px. At <=600px the wordmark hides and the mark is 25px. Footer lockup 18px.

provider_icons.treatment: Full colour, no grayscale, no opacity change

diagram.connector: 2px wide, repeating 4px dash / 4px gap in {color.line.connector} at 70% opacity; background-position animates over {duration.connector}, linear, infinite

imagery.icons: Inline SVG line icons, 18px, currentColor. Tertiary links end with a '→' glyph.

search.shortcut_hint: kbd, shown for fine pointers only

header.mobile: At <=880px links move into a menu drawer opened by a 44px Menu button; Sign in moves into the drawer at <=480px
header.status: Status indicator sits in the nav row after Docs
header.note: Every page shares this header. Match it exactly.

components.button_pair: Primary then secondary, gap 16px, each min-width 180px; at <=600px both share the row equally (flex 1, padding 12px 8px, 15px text)

action_link.suffix: →, 8px gap, moves 3px right on hover over {duration.base}

tag.behaviour: Every privacy tag opens its tooltip on hover, focus and tap

chip.use: Copyable routing promises: trustedrouter/auto, zdr, e2e, eu, synth

tooltip_copy.ZDR: Zero data retention. The provider keeps no prompts or outputs.
tooltip_copy.E2EE: Confidential compute with end-to-end encryption. The prompt stays encrypted until it reaches verified provider hardware.
tooltip_copy.auto: Healthy provider rollover. For general production traffic.
tooltip_copy.zdr: Zero-retention providers only. For legal and sensitive work.
tooltip_copy.e2e: Confidential provider compute. For confidential workloads.
tooltip_copy.synth: Multiple models, one answer. For combination models.

data_table.head: {type.label} in {color.text.tertiary}, padding 6px 12px 10px, bottom 1px {color.line.rule-soft}
data_table.columns_desktop: table-layout fixed: name auto, routes 22%, input 140px, output 140px, context 100px
data_table.below_600: Each row becomes a card: grid 2 columns, gap 8px 16px, padding 16px 0, bottom 1px {color.line.rule-soft}. Name and routes span both columns; each number shows its column label in {type.data-unit} above the value. The table header is hidden. Between 601 and 880px the table keeps its columns.

proof_split.grid: minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1.15fr), column gap 40px; one column at <=700px
proof_split.lead: {type.h3-lg} + {type.body} + checklist + secondary button; right border 1px {color.line.rule}, padding 20px 40px 20px 0
proof_split.items: Stacked, each {type.h3} + {type.body} + action link, padding 20px 0, bottom border 1px {color.line.rule}

code_panel.container: Panel component with padding 0, overflow hidden
code_panel.toolbar: Segmented tabs (Python, TypeScript, cURL, Agent prompt) + source toggle (from OpenAI / OpenRouter), padding 14px, bottom 1px {color.line.rule}
code_panel.diff: Removed lines {color.diff.removed-text} on {color.diff.removed-bg} with '-'; added lines {color.diff.added-text} on {color.diff.added-bg} with '+'; both bleed to the panel edges
code_panel.footer: Hint text 14px {color.text.tertiary} left, 44px copy icon button right, min-height 52px, top 1px {color.line.rule}
code_panel.copy_field: {type.label} above a 48px field on {color.surface.panel-inset}, mono 14px value, copy icon button inside the field

route_receipt.header: {type.eyebrow} left ('CAPTURED REQUEST'), model slug right; 11px at <=600px

terms_grid.cell: padding 4px 24px (20px at <=1000px, 16px 12px at <=700px), left 1px {color.panel-blue.divider}; at <=1000px the second row also gets a top divider
terms_grid.title: Archivo 25px/1.2, weight 600, letter-spacing -0.025em, in {color.panel-blue.ink} (21px at <=700px)

parts: {type.quote} in {color.panel-mint.ink-2} with 2px {color.line.quote} left rule, padding-left 20px (16px text and padding at <=700px)

press_card.layout: Three columns at >=701px (source, quote, link), stacked below

accordion.row: Bottom 1px {color.line.rule}; first row also has a top rule
accordion.question: {type.question} in {color.text.primary}, min-height 56px, padding 18px 4px; turns {color.accent.base} on hover
accordion.icon: '+' Archivo 22px/300 in {color.text.tertiary}; rotates 45° and turns {color.accent.base} when open

footer.brand_row: Mark lockup (18px). No status indicator; status lives in the header
footer.columns: 5 equal columns, gap 24px 28px, ordered by traffic; 3 columns at <=880px; collapsible disclosures at <=600px
footer.heading: {type.footer-heading}
footer.base: {type.legal} in {color.text.tertiary}, top 1px {color.line.rule-soft}, + 44px round back-to-top button with 1px {color.line.rule} border

marquee.content: Frontier lab icons (30px, 28px at <=600px) + model names, Archivo 14px/1.6 in {color.text.on-photo} with a soft dark text-shadow; each item is a button that searches that model
marquee.animation: translateX(-50%) over {duration.marquee}, linear, infinite; pauses on pointer hover and keyboard focus, never on tap

status_indicator.dot: 8px circle in the matching color.status token
status_indicator.glow: 0 0 0 3px status colour at 20%, 0 0 10px status colour at 60%
status_indicator.label: {type.nav} in {color.header.link}
status_indicator.states: Up: 'All systems operational' (pulsing). Degraded and down use their colours. When the server marks the last check stale (about 5 minutes), the dot turns {color.status.unknown} and the label reads 'Status delayed'.

layout.container: max-width {space.container}, margin-inline auto, padding-inline {space.gutter} ({space.gutter-1200} at <=1200px, {space.gutter-600} at <=600px). The header uses {space.header-inline} instead
layout.section: padding-block {space.section} ({space.section-mobile} at <=700px). Alternate {color.surface.bg} and {color.surface.bg-alt}; bg-alt bands get a 1px {color.line.rule-soft} top and bottom border
layout.hero: Centred column: promises, display H1, lede-hero, button_pair, marquee. Photo band, min-height 100svh minus header

grids.collapse: Request, migration and FAQ grids become one column at <=1000px; proof split at <=700px; terms grid 4 → 2 at <=1000px; footer 5 → 3 at <=880px, then disclosures at <=600px

motion.loops: Connector, status pulse and marquee loop linearly (pulse ease-in-out)
motion.reduced_motion: All loops stop; the link-arrow nudge and tooltip transition are removed

accessibility.contrast: All text/background pairs in this file meet WCAG AA 4.5:1. Checked: primary/bg 18.6, secondary/bg 12.0, tertiary/bg 10.1, tertiary/panel 9.3, quaternary/bg-deep 7.5, link/bg 14.9, accent ink/accent 12.5, panel-blue ink-2 7.4, panel-mint ink-2 7.5, ZDR 10.8, E2EE 12.3, diff removed 8.4, diff added 10.4.
accessibility.focus: 3px solid {color.focus} (mint), offset 4px, on every link, button, input, summary and tab. Inside panel-mint (the customer story card) use {color.panel-mint.ink} instead, because mint on mint is invisible.
accessibility.targets: 44px minimum; 48px for primary and secondary buttons
accessibility.hover_parity: Every hover reveal also works on focus and tap
accessibility.overflow: No horizontal scroll at 360px and above
accessibility.skip_link: 'Skip to content' is the first focusable element

voice.headlines: Short declarative sentences, often two beats, concrete over adjectival: 'Don't trust. Verify.' 'See what your AI bill is made of.'

ctas.tertiary: Verb + object + →, e.g. 'Open live trust evidence →'

rules: Definitions live in tooltips, not footnotes.
Model and provider counts come from the live catalog, never hard-coded.

/models: Optional photo band (inner_page_band) with {type.display}: '{live_model_count} models. Every route labeled.'
/models/{lab}/{model}: {type.display} model name, slug in {type.id}, privacy tags
Provider route data_table: provider, tags, input, output, context, uptime
/compare/{competitor}: {type.display} 'TrustedRouter vs {Competitor}' with an italic accent payoff
Comparison data_table: one fact per row, values in {type.data}, privacy as tags, a source action_link per row
code_panel with the source toggle set to the competitor

homepage_exceptions._use: The live homepage differs from this kit in these places. The kit is correct: build new pages from the kit, not from the homepage code.

items.what: Focus ring inside the mint customer story card
items.homepage: Mint ring on the mint card, which is invisible
Slightly different greys, rules and panel fills (the values listed in migration)

migration._use: When restyling older trustedrouter.com pages, replace each value on the left with the token on the right.
